```plato
    // The quaternion of an axis-angle rotation.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Axis%E2%80%93angle_representation
    Quaternion(aa: AxisAngle): Quaternion
        => Quaternion.CreateFromAxisAngle(aa.Axis.Vector, aa.Angle);
```

## Line 1249

```plato

    // The quaternion of chained elemental rotations, honoring the explicit
    // application order. X carries Pitch, Y carries Yaw, Z carries Roll.
    Quaternion(e: EulerAngles): Quaternion =>
        e.Order.ChainRotations(
            Quaternion.CreateRotationX(e.Pitch),
            Quaternion.CreateRotationY(e.Yaw),
            Quaternion.CreateRotationZ(e.Roll));
```

```plato
    // The quaternion of a rotor, under the isomorphism (w, x, y, z) =
    // (Scalar, YZ, ZX, XY): each bivector plane maps to the quaternion unit
    // whose axis is perpendicular to it.
    Quaternion(r: Rotor3D): Quaternion
        => (r.Bivector.YZ, r.Bivector.ZX, r.Bivector.XY, r.Scalar);
```

```plato
    // The quaternion of a rotation matrix. Precondition: the upper 3x3 block
    // is orthonormal (a pure rotation, no scale or shear).
    Quaternion(m: Matrix4x4): Quaternion
        => Quaternion.CreateFromRotationMatrix(m);
```
